how.title: How Kolabo works
how.subtitle: Three steps from sign-up to collaboration.
how.step1Text: Connect your networks, pick your content categories and add your audience ranges. Everything in one place — like your media kit.
how.step2Text: Define price ranges for your services, choose whether you accept barter deals and how you want to be contacted.
how.step3Text: Brands find you by category, audience and budget. You decide who you work with and how.

categories.title: For every type of content
categories.subtitle: Pick up to 5 categories that best describe your content — that is how brands find you.

networks.title: All your networks on one profile
networks.subtitle: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn — one profile instead of five links.

forBrands.title: Running a brand?
forBrands.subtitle: Coming soon: company accounts with creator search by category, audience and budget. Join the waitlist.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Creating a profile and basic use of the platform is free for creators.
faq.q2: How many followers do I need?
faq.a2: There is no minimum follower count. Brands care about audience engagement, content quality and category fit — not just numbers.
faq.a3: A collaboration where instead of money you receive products, services, travel or tickets in exchange for a post. On your profile you choose whether and under which conditions you accept barter.
faq.a4: You choose: platform messages, email, phone, WhatsApp, Viber or Instagram DM. We only show what you allow.

cta.title: Ready for your first collaboration?
cta.subtitle: Build your profile once — opportunities keep coming. It's free.
